subsystems.name: Translation
subsystems.description: Body-axis force equations: du/dt, dv/dt, dw/dt from force per mass and the rotating frame.

subsystems.name: Rotation
subsystems.description: Body-axis moment equations with the full inertia tensor (Ixx, Iyy, Izz, Ixz).

subsystems.name: Attitude and position
subsystems.description: Attitude quaternion (body to north-east-down), direction cosines, Euler angles, flat-earth position and the unwrapped track angle.

subsystems.name: Propulsion
subsystems.description: Engine: thrust available from ISA height and Mach number, first-order spool lag, thrust along body x through the engine station.

subsystems.name: Mixer and actuators
subsystems.description: Pitch command to the stabilator, flap and aileron commands to the two flaperons, position limits, rate-limited first-order actuators for the stabilator, the flaperons and the rudder; landing gear travel.

inputs.label: table: flap command (both flaperons trailing edge down)
table: landing gear command (0 up, 1 down)

subsystems.name: Pitch law
subsystems.description: Load-factor command law with angle-of-attack limiter: gains from the short-period derivatives and dynamic pressure, integral action as a stabilator trim state.

subsystems.name: Guidance
subsystems.description: Commands from the time tables: track, bank or roll rate; height or load factor; speed or throttle. Bank command for a level turn at the available load factor, height hold through load factor, speed hold, throttle.

subsystems.name: Roll and yaw laws
subsystems.description: Bank-angle hold through a roll-rate command; roll stick as a rate command with attitude hold (a bank reference that the stick moves); sideslip command and turn coordination with the rudder; aileron-to-rudder interconnect. Gains from the roll and yaw derivatives and dynamic pressure.

subsystems.name: Commands
subsystems.description: Command inputs as time tables (linear interpolation of workspace vectors over one time vector) and an optional track step. Written by schedule.py from a schedule; constant for a trim run.

table: landing gear command (0 up, 1 down)

subsystems.name: Air data
subsystems.description: ISA atmosphere from height; true airspeed, angle of attack, sideslip, dynamic pressure and Mach number from the body velocity.

subsystems.name: Aerodynamics
subsystems.description: Coefficients about the moment reference point: lift (with a maximum and a stall break), drag and pitching moment tables over angle of attack; stabilator, flaperon and rudder derivatives; landing gear increments; sideslip and damping derivatives; forces in body axes.

subsystems.name: Gravity
subsystems.description: Weight resolved into body axes with the third row of the direction cosine matrix.

subsystems.name: Forces and moments
subsystems.description: Sum of aerodynamic force, thrust and weight at the centre of gravity; aerodynamic moments moved from the reference point to the centre of gravity; thrust-line moment; load factors.

subsystems.name: Sensors
subsystems.description: Rate gyros, accelerometers and attitude reference in the avionics bay; air data from the probe. Ideal taps: no lag, no noise, sensed at the centre of gravity.
